notes.title: 1 hour after release patch
notes.content:
Quickly patched an issue where failing the boss would cause credits to play.

Thank you jadon for the tip

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
[b]Beat Defender's Early Access Release Date has finally arrived! Thank you all for the support of buying the game and supporting the Denver Rescue Mission![/b]

I definitely have a planned road map for what I want to add, but feel free to discuss what issues you may have with the game and what features I should add! I will be watching reviews and steam discussions closely over the next few weeks.
